metadata.question: In the Norwegian Sea during Septermber 19, 2019, is the water color at (46.694935, -50.925784) more milky than (46.809436, -58.528990)?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: MODIS-Aqua imagery (daily, ocean color). - Collection: NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI - Band: ‘chlor_a’ is standard for water color, but for “milky” we look for high turbidity or backscatter. We will use the 869 nm NIR band (Rrs_869) as a proxy for whitish turbid water and also the derived “turbidity” band (t) if available in the L3SMI product. Rrs_869 ~ high → likely milky. - Date: “2019-09-19” (single day). - Points: – P1 = (46.694935, -50.925784) – east, shallower (Grand Banks slope) → expected higher turbidity, i.e. milkier. – P2 = (46.809436, -58.528990) – west, deeper → clearer. 2. Masking: MODIS L3SMI is daily 4 km composite already masked for clouds; we just clip to points; no cloud mask needed. 3. Check for data: if collection size is 0 → C1. After reduction, if pixel count is 0 at either point → C2. If result None/NaN → C3. Otherwise compare mean Rrs_869 values: higher value = milkier. Print both Rrs_869 values and conclude A (yes) if P1 > P2, else B (no). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # geometry p1 = ee.Geometry.Point([-50.925784, 46.694935]) p2 = ee.Geometry.Point([-58.528990, 46.809436]) date = '2019-09-19' col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') \ .filterDate(date, date) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No images for 2019-09-19.") print("C1") else: img = col.first() # Use 869 nm remote-sensing reflectance as turbidity proxy band = 'Rrs_869' # valid pixel counts c1 = img.select(band).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=p1, scale=4000, maxPixels=1e9).get(band).getInfo() c2 = img.select(band).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=p2, scale=4000, maxPixels=1e9).get(band).getInfo() if (c1 is None) or (c2 is None) or (c1 == 0) or (c2 == 0): print("No valid pixels.") print("C2") else: v1 = img.select(band).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=p1, scale=4000, maxPixels=1e9).get(band).getInfo() v2 = img.select(band).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=p2, scale=4000, maxPixels=1e9).get(band).getInfo() if (v1 is None) or (v2 is None): print("Calculation failed.") print("C3") else: print(f"East Pt Rrs_869: {v1:.4f} (px: {c1})") print(f"West Pt Rrs_869: {v2:.4f} (px: {c2})") if v1 > v2: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# geometry
p1 = ee.Geometry.Point([-50.925784, 46.694935])
p2 = ee.Geometry.Point([-58.528990, 46.809436])

date = '2019-09-19'
col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') \
        .filterDate(date, date)

if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No images for 2019-09-19.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    img = col.first()
    # Use 869 nm remote-sensing reflectance as turbidity proxy
    band = 'Rrs_869'
    
    # valid pixel counts
    c1 = img.select(band).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=p1, scale=4000, maxPixels=1e9).get(band).getInfo()
    c2 = img.select(band).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=p2, scale=4000, maxPixels=1e9).get(band).getInfo()
    if (c1 is None) or (c2 is None) or (c1 == 0) or (c2 == 0):
        print("No valid pixels.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        v1 = img.select(band).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=p1, scale=4000, maxPixels=1e9).get(band).getInfo()
        v2 = img.select(band).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=p2, scale=4000, maxPixels=1e9).get(band).getInfo()
        if (v1 is None) or (v2 is None):
            print("Calculation failed.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            print(f"East Pt Rrs_869: {v1:.4f} (px: {c1})")
            print(f"West Pt Rrs_869: {v2:.4f} (px: {c2})")
            if v1 > v2:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
